articles.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
articles.description:
Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hours
Austrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty.
Authorities in the capital released pictures of the suspects captured by security cameras during the heist at the Museum of Applied Arts (MAK), amid a rash of spectacular smash-and-grab thefts from European cultural institutions.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: What could Meta’s US settlement mean around the world – and what now for other claims against firm?
articles.description:
Other governments could seek similar concessions, while separate legal action is pending in places ranging from Kenya to the Netherlands
In October 2021, Abrham Meareg’s father, a professor of chemistry in Ethiopia’s northern town of Bahir Dar, was shot at close range and died outside his family home. This was in the middle of the country’s civil war.
For weeks, Facebook’s algorithm had actively promoted posts calling for the academic to be murdered, according to Meareg and Foxglove, a nonprofit organisation supporting Meareg’s lawsuit against the company in Kenya. These posts included photos of his father and his home address.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: UK urged to help free British-Egyptian ‘arrested in Cairo over sister’s activism’
articles.description:
Lawyers claim Eman el-Shazly, from Birmingham, was detained in effort to silence her sister, a critic of Sisi regime
The UK Foreign Office has been asked to intervene to secure the release of a British-Egyptian woman who it is claimed has been arrested in Cairo because of her sister’s political activism.
Eman el-Shazly, a 45-year-old based in Birmingham, was arrested on 16 August while visiting Egypt. Her lawyers say she has been detained in an attempt to silence her sister Mona, a relentless and harsh critic of the Egyptian government on her UK-based YouTube channel.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: South African police arrest two Thai men for allegedly smuggling parrot eggs
articles.description:
Bird eggs intercepted in homemade incubators at Johannesburg airport as officials try to halt wildlife trafficking
South African police have arrested two Thai nationals in separate incidents for allegedly attempting to smuggle endangered parrot eggs out of the country as authorities try to stem the tide of wildlife trafficking.
A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested at OR Tambo international airport in Johannesburg on 20 August, carrying 50 bird eggs in a homemade incubator in a hand-luggage bag, South Africa’s environment ministry said in a statement.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Mpox is back – and in new countries. How can this outbreak be contained?
articles.description:
The public health emergencies in 2022 and 2024 saw the virus reported in 145 countries, but in the new cases children appear particularly affected
A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau – the country’s first – means the virus formerly known as monkey pox is back in the headlines. So what has changed?
Since 2022, there have been almost 190,000 lab-confirmed cases of mpox reported worldwide in 145 countries. Before then, outbreaks of mpox tended to be relatively small and in a handful of African countries, where the viral infection was known to be endemic.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: Mpoxが再燃、新たな国々にも拡大。この流行をどう封じ込めるか？

articles.title: They laid down arms. Now ex-guerrillas in Colombia fear fate under new hardline president
articles.description:
‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreements
In mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenade launchers.
They also stripped off their heavy tactical vests, field packs and camouflage uniforms, which were each piled into a bonfire to mark the beginning of a new life away from an armed conflict that has claimed nearly half a million lives in the last six decades.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Trump announces new US oil agreement with Venezuela
articles.description:
US president says US will have ‘majority’ control of 65bn barrels of proven oil reserves
Donald Trump announced Friday a new US oil agreement with Venezuela’s interim president Delcy Rodríguez, saying the US will have “majority” control of 65bn barrels of proven oil reserves.
The terms of the agreement remain to be seen, but the US president said on his social-media platform that it had been brokered “through a partnership with ⁠private business” by his secretary of state, Marco Rubio, and defense secretary, Pete Hegseth.

articles.title: Venezuelan opposition up in arms over reports US wants big stake in oil and gas
articles.description:

Reports that the US is preparing to claim a big stake in Venezuela’s massive energy reserves have sparked an outcry, with critics describing the move as “predatory” and a “rapacious” land grab.
Several media outlets this week reported that the Trump administration – which abducted Venezuela’s authoritarian president, Nicolás Maduro, in January and has steered the South American country ever since – hopes to secure long-term access to its oil and gasfields.

articles.title: Tropical Storm Dolly downgraded to ‘open tropical wave’ as it heads to Caribbean
articles.description:
Remnants from tropical storm could cause heavy rainfall on Leeward Islands and affect Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico and Hispaniola
Remnants of Tropical Storm Dolly, which has been downgraded to an “open tropical wave”, were moving still across the Atlantic Ocean toward the Leeward Islands, and could bring heavy rainfall to parts of the Caribbean this weekend, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said on Friday..
Dolly, which formed on Thursday, had maximum sustained winds of near 40mph (65km/h) with higher gusts on Friday morning. Later on Friday, forecasters said that Dolly was no longer a Tropical Storm, and had “become an open tropical wave”.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Detroit despairs as ‘insanity’ of Trump’s Canada trade war punishes city
articles.description:

News this week of Donald Trump’s escalating trade spat with Canada has everyone worried. Political and economic leaders and observers labeled the move an act of “hubris” , blamed Trump’s “ego”, and called the escalation “insanity”.

articles.summary: 35年間在位した故国王は、平民との結婚という伝統を破り、ノルウェー国民に広く愛された。

articles.title: Allan Little: I met dangerously fanatical Mladić early in Bosnian war
articles.description: BBC special correspondent Allan Little met the "Butcher of Bosnia" in the early months of the Bosnian war.
articles.titleJa: アラン・リトル：ボスニア戦争初期に危険な狂信者ムラディッチに会った
articles.summary: BBC特派員アラン・リトルは、ボスニア戦争初期に「ボスニアの肉屋」と称されたムラディッチに面会した。

articles.title: Colombia's new president approves extradition of rebel leaders to US
articles.description: It is a step towards ending a plan to stop violence by bringing rebel and criminal groups to the negotiating table.
articles.titleJa: コロンビア新大統領、反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認
articles.summary: コロンビアの新大統領が、暴力終結を目指す和平計画の一環として、反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認した。

articles.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
articles.description: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.
articles.titleJa: マラドーナの「神の手」ボール、250万ポンドで落札
articles.summary: ディエゴ・マラドーナが1986年W杯で「神の手」ゴールを決めたサッカーボールが、競売で250万ポンド（約4億円）で落札された。

articles.title: US sanctions more Cuban companies and officials
articles.description: An international socialist institute and Cuba's construction ministry are subject to the latest US sanctions, Marco Rubio announces.
articles.titleJa: 米国、キューバの企業・当局者に追加制裁
articles.summary: マルコ・ルビオ氏が発表した最新の米国制裁により、キューバの国際社会主義研究所と建設省が対象となった。

articles.title: Peru earthquake damages buildings and causes power cuts
articles.description: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Ayacucho region on Thursday, the US Geological Survey says.
articles.titleJa: ペルー地震、建物に被害、停電が発生
articles.summary: 米地質調査所によると、ペルーのアヤクーチョ地域でマグニチュード6.7の地震が発生し、建物に被害が生じ、停電も引き起こした。

articles.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
articles.description: The crucial waterway's operator says low rainfall caused by the ocean pattern had led to the decision.
articles.titleJa: パナマ運河、エルニーニョ現象により通過船舶数を削減へ
articles.summary: パナマ運河庁は、エルニーニョ現象による少雨が原因で、運河を通過する船舶数を削減することを決定した。

articles.title: Landslide at unlicensed Colombian gold mine kills 13
articles.description: Four members of an indigenous family are among the dead, witnesses said.
articles.titleJa: コロンビアの無許可金鉱で地滑り、13人死亡
articles.summary: コロンビアの無許可金鉱で発生した地滑りにより、目撃者によると先住民家族4人を含む13人が死亡した。

articles.title: Messi's most iconic moments as he ponders retirement
articles.description: As Lionel Messi considers his footballing future following the death of his father, BBC Sport looks back at some of his most iconic moments.
articles.titleJa: メッシ、引退を検討中にその最も象徴的な瞬間を振り返る
articles.summary: リオネル・メッシが父の死を受けサッカー選手としての将来を考えている中、BBCスポーツが彼のキャリアを彩る象徴的な瞬間を振り返る。

articles.title: The Argentine who wishes he could play for Wales
articles.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
articles.titleJa: ウェールズ代表でのプレーを望むアルゼンチン人選手
articles.summary: ウェールズにルーツを持つチリを拠点とするアルゼンチン人DFヘレミアス・ジェームズが、国際試合でのプレーを可能にするルール変更を望んでいる。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: ライブ配信者の殺害、メキシコのクリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問を投げかける
articles.summary: 火曜日に発生したコンテンツクリエイター、セサル・ガステルムの殺害事件は、インフルエンサーが攻撃される理由について疑問を投げかけている。

articles.title: 'My grandmother subjected my baby to female genital mutilation behind my back'
articles.description: In Colombia, where FGM is still practised by some members of an indigenous group, a landmark bill banning the practice has been enacted.
articles.titleJa: 「祖母が私の知らないところで赤ちゃんに女性器切除を行った」
articles.summary: コロンビアでは一部の先住民グループで女性器切除（FGM）が今も行われており、この行為を禁止する画期的な法案が制定された。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安をもたらす
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、幼い子供たちは恐怖、日常生活の混乱、基本的な栄養保障の喪失に直面している。家族が避難所を求める中、特に子供たちが深刻な影響を受けている。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
articles.summary: ブラジルでは政治的・経済的圧力により、先住民の土地紛争と殺害が増加している。先住民の権利を擁護する団体は、権利の枠組みに関する膠着状態が暴力の増加につながっていると指摘。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球の溜息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震後、あまり報じられないコミュニティの静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真と個人の証言で記録するプロジェクト。見過ごされた人々の声と状況に焦点を当てる。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な環境と不十分な支援の中、倒壊した建物のそばで肉親の捜索を続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで裁判所の判決が、無国籍で書類のない女性の物語に光を当てる
articles.summary: ブラジルで、40年間書類も公式身分も持たなかったボリビア生まれの女性が、裁判所の判決により移民ステータスを正規化し、無国籍者としての認定手続きを開始できた。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラが燃えている、私は遠くからそれを見ざるを得ない
articles.summary: メキシコシティから、ある亡命ベネズエラ人が祖国が崩壊するのをリアルタイムで見守る。権威主義的な放置と故郷への隔たりに直面する無力感を語る。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権の武器化：ニカラグアにおける反対意見の封じ込め
articles.summary: ニカラグアで、政府が市民権を武器として利用し、反対意見を封じ込める権威主義的な手法について検証する。市民権剥奪が政敵や活動家に対して行われている。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラが地震後に再建するにはどれほどの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後の再建には、前例のない財政資源と長期的な経済復興努力が必要となる。被害額の初期推定は様々だが、膨大な費用がかかるという結論は一致している。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラの命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコ在住のベネズエラ人が、祖国での災害を受けて数時間で救援活動を開始。信頼できるネットワークを構築し、国境を越えた連帯が命を救うことができると証明した。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察暴力への支持に異議を唱えるのにどう役立ったか
articles.summary: ブラジルでは警察暴力に対する大規模な国民の支持が問題となってきたが、AI研究ツールがこの問題に異議を唱える手助けをした。2023年には高い意図的暴力死者数を記録している。

articles.title: Satellite images reveal scale of flood devastation in Nepal villages
articles.description: Before-and-after images show villages, bridges and a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing washed away by devastating floodwaters.
articles.titleJa: 衛星画像がネパールの村々における洪水被害の規模を明らかに
articles.summary: 衛星画像が、ネパールの村々、橋、チベット国境の主要な地点が壊滅的な洪水によって流された様子を映し出している。

articles.title: Videos show people survive floodwaters on balcony in Nepal
articles.description: BBC Verify has located several videos from disaster-struck areas of the Trishuli river after deadly floods swept through.
articles.titleJa: 動画がネパールで人々がバルコニーで洪水から生き延びる様子を映す
articles.summary: ネパールのトリシュリ川流域で発生した壊滅的な洪水後、人々がバルコニーで洪水から生き延びる姿を捉えた複数の動画が特定された。

articles.title: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
articles.description: A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, survived the flash floods and was rescued using an excavator.
articles.titleJa: ネパール洪水後に救助された97歳女性は「戦士のようだった」
articles.summary: ネパールでの鉄砲水から生還し、ショベルカーを使って救助された97歳の女性、グナ・マヤ・ボハラさんの感動的な物語。

articles.title: Blocked roads and devastation as BBC drives to site of Nepal floods
articles.description: South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri reports as she travels from Kathmandu to Trishuli, passing ambulances and hearses on the way.
articles.titleJa: ネパール洪水現場への移動中、封鎖された道路と荒廃をBBCが報じる
articles.summary: BBC特派員がカトマンズからトリシュリへ向かう道中で、ネパールの洪水による道路封鎖と甚大な被害状況を報告。

articles.title: Nepal army rescues survivors from hydropower tunnel
articles.description: Officials say more than 100 people were thought to have been trapped in the tunnel in Rasuwa.
articles.titleJa: ネパール軍が水力発電所のトンネルから生存者を救出
articles.summary: ネパール軍が、ラシュワの水力発電所のトンネルに閉じ込められていた100人以上の生存者を救出した。

articles.title: Wife of man who died after turbulence sues Singapore Airlines
articles.description: Lawyers for Linda Kitchen say her husband was "fatally injured" after the flight dropped 6,000 ft.
articles.titleJa: 乱気流で死亡した男性の妻がシンガポール航空を提訴
articles.summary: 乱気流により夫が死亡したとして、リンダ・キッチンさんがシンガポール航空を提訴。機体が6,000フィート急降下したとされる。

articles.title: The heartbreak of reporting from a camp housing Nepal flood survivors
articles.description: A BBC Nepali reporter witnesses helicopters coming and going in one of the most flood-devastated areas.
articles.titleJa: ネパール洪水生存者収容キャンプからの報道の悲痛さ
articles.summary: BBCネパール人記者が、洪水で最も被害の大きかった地域の一つにある生存者収容キャンプから、心痛む報道をする。

articles.title: 'High risk' of lake breaching and causing second flood, warns China
articles.description: Authorities say a lake formed after a recent landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border may breach in the coming days.
articles.titleJa: 「湖が決壊し、二度目の洪水を引き起こす高いリスク」と中国が警告
articles.summary: ネパールとチベット国境付近で発生した地滑りにより形成された湖が決壊し、数日中に二度目の洪水を引き起こす「高いリスク」があると中国当局が警告した。

articles.title: Sarfaraz denies knowing about Pakistan threat to end tour
articles.description: Head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed says he and his players did not know about a Pakistan Cricket Board threat to the England and Wales Cricket Board over a Sky interview with the sons of Imran Khan.
articles.titleJa: サルファラズ、パキスタンのツアー中止脅迫を知らなかったと否定
articles.summary: サルファラズ監督は、パキスタンクリケット委員会がイムラン・カーン元首相の息子たちのインタビューを巡り、イングランド・ウェールズクリケット委員会にツアー中止を脅迫したことを知らなかったと述べた。

articles.title: Why India wants Bangladesh's Tarique Rahman in Delhi
articles.description: India is keen to reset ties with Bangladesh, but old tensions and new regional alliances complicate its efforts.
articles.titleJa: なぜインドはバングラデシュのタリク・ラフマンをデリーに望むのか
articles.summary: インドはバングラデシュとの関係を再構築したがっているが、長年の緊張と新たな地域同盟がその取り組みを複雑にしている。

articles.title: WTO members adopt panel report regarding EU duties on fatty acid from Indonesia
articles.description: At a meeting on 28 August of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB), WTO members adopted a panel report regarding the European Union’s anti-dumping duties on imports of fatty acid from Indonesia.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、インドネシアからの脂肪酸に対するEU関税に関するパネル報告書を採択
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は、インドネシア産脂肪酸に対するEUのアンチダンピング関税に関するパネル報告書を採択した。これはEUとインドネシア間の貿易紛争の解決に向けた動きである。

articles.title: Deadline to register for 2026 Public Forum is 21 August
articles.description: The deadline for online registration for this year’s in-person Public Forum, which will take place on 15, 16 and 17 September, is 21 August 2026 (23.59 CET). Late and onsite registrations will not be accepted.
articles.titleJa: 2026年公開フォーラムの登録締め切りは8月21日
articles.summary: 2026年9月に開催されるWTO公開フォーラムのオンライン登録締め切りは8月21日である。期日を過ぎた登録は受け付けられない。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
articles.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
articles.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国は、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。これは英国の貿易政策に影響を与える。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易・技術デー、AIを包摂的貿易に活用する政策を模索
articles.summary: WTOはジュネーブで初の「世界貿易・技術デー」を開催し、AI戦略が国際貿易の利益を最大化するためにどう貢献できるかについて議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 2026年第1四半期、中東紛争にもかかわらず世界の物品貿易は回復力示す
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の世界の物品貿易は、AI関連電子部品の貿易急増により、中東紛争の悪影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税に関する紛争を開始
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国がブラジル産品に課した追加関税について、WTO紛争協議を米国に要請した。これは米国の通商法に基づく調査に起因する。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコのEVおよびその他車両に関する措置に関する報告書を発表
articles.summary: WTOは、中国が提起したトルコの電気自動車（EV）およびその他の車両に関する措置についてのパネル報告書を回覧した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、開発途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを供与
articles.summary: リトアニアは、開発途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員向け研修プログラムに3万ユーロを拠出し、WTO問題への理解を深め貿易システムへの参加を支援する。

articles.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
articles.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
articles.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な協力に感謝
articles.summary: ウズベキスタンは、2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認した。交渉の継続と懸念事項への対処が成功の鍵となる。

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度に関する紛争パネルを要請
articles.summary: ロシア連邦は、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズム（CBAM）および排出量取引制度について、紛争解決パネルの設置をWTOに要請した。
